articles.headline: Jio Reaches $137 Billion Valuation in India
articles.brief: Ambani’s Jio has hit a $137 billion valuation, making it India’s second-most valuable firm following a record IPO celebration.

articles.headline: Cyclone Arnab Strikes Eastern India
articles.brief: Cyclone Arnab has hit eastern India, resulting in three deaths, widespread infrastructure and crop damage, and thousands of evacuations.

articles.headline: High-Speed Train Collision Kills Dozens in Spain
articles.brief: At least 30 people were killed when two high-speed trains collided in Spain, prompting emergency rescue operations and government investigations into operator error.

articles.headline: China Implements New Export Curbs on AI
articles.brief: China has introduced strict new export curbs protecting its critical artificial intelligence technologies, drawing a sharp line around its domestic tech sector crown jewels.

articles.headline: Qatari Mediators Present New Iran Deal
articles.brief: Qatari mediators have officially presented Iran with a new diplomatic deal aimed at bringing an end to the ongoing conflict, according to official sources.

articles.headline: Stellantis Operating Profit Rises on Cost Cuts
articles.brief: Automaker Stellantis reported an increase in operating profit as aggressive corporate cost-cutting measures successfully gained traction across global operations.

articles.headline: Oil Prices Surge Following Refinery Attack
articles.brief: Crude oil prices rose over 1% after an attack on a Saudi Arabian refinery reignited global concerns over immediate energy supply risks.

articles.headline: OpenAI Plans to Purchase Google AI Chips
articles.brief: Reports indicate that OpenAI is planning to purchase artificial intelligence chips from rival tech giant Google to support its expanding workload requirements.

articles.headline: India and Mexico Launch Trade Talks
articles.brief: India and Mexico have officially begun negotiations for a new preferential trade agreement to boost bilateral merchandise trade and expand economic cooperation.

articles.headline: Israel Opposition Urges Coalition with Arab Parties
articles.brief: Opposition figures in Israel are urging bloc leaders to form a governing coalition featuring Arab parties in order to successfully oust Prime Minister Netanyahu.

articles.headline: Microsoft Offers Buyouts to Global Employees
articles.brief: Microsoft has launched a voluntary exit offer providing buyouts to roughly 60,000 employees across multiple global regions, excluding sales teams, with a December deadline.

articles.headline: India Series Drives Record Cricket Australia Revenue
articles.brief: Cricket Australia reported record financial revenue driven heavily by recent India series fixtures, helping offset heavy deficits incurred by shortened matches.

articles.headline: Global Domestic Workers Earn 53% of Average
articles.brief: A new ILO estimate reveals that domestic workers globally earn only 53% of what other employees make, reflecting a continuous decline from previous years.

articles.headline: Real Madrid Apologizes for Mbappe Mao Comment
articles.brief: Real Madrid issued a formal apology to Chinese citizens following a backlash over remarks made by Kylian Mbappe regarding former leader Mao Zedong.

articles.headline: Global Air Quality Study Wins Science Prize
articles.brief: A 15-year-old student from Florida won a national science prize for designing an affordable air sampler capable of collecting and analyzing airborne bacterial DNA.
